The voting system is not effective for debate.

The voting system was originially effective because people were democratically sorting data. Everyone had similar values, because the topic wasn't politics, it was tech. A good story about Microsoft would float to the top, and an advertisement from Microsoft would be downvoted into oblivion.

When the group is divided, such as for a political issue, you end up with two different groups of sorters working against each other. Obviously, the bigger group wins.

Reddit and Voat will never be a place for lively debate. The mechanic is and always has been a democratized sorting mechanism for people with common views.

The voting system would bearable by itself, but then you get people who see you've said a thing that they disagree with because politics, and they're sorting through all your posts voting them down to make sure you never get seen again.
